多數人是在手機上、出門前或已經在附近時才搜尋。他們要的不是長篇品牌故事，而是幾個: Most people search on their phone, before heading out or when they are already nearby. They do not want a long brand story. They want practical answers: are you open now, should they book for the weekend, are there outlets and Wi-Fi, can they bring a pet, are today’s desserts still available.
這些資訊如果只放在 IG 貼文或限時動態裡，客人得一則一則往回滑；Google: If that information lives only in Instagram posts or stories, customers have to scroll back through them one by one, and Google Maps hours are often out of date. 吧台、座位、窗邊、插座位置。客人想知道適不適合聊天、看書或工作。: The bar, seating, window seats and where the outlets are. Customers want to know if it suits chatting, reading or working.
週末容易客滿的店，放一個預約或包場表單，比在 IG 私訊來回問有效率。: If you fill up on weekends, a booking or private-event form works better than going back and forth in Instagram messages.

一頁式網頁把店家介紹、服務或菜單、照片、常見問題、地址與聯絡方式，由上往下排在同: A one-page website lays out your introduction, services or menu, photos, FAQs, address and contact details from top to bottom on one page. Visitors just keep scrolling, with no switching between pages, which works especially well on phones.
適合的情況：服務項目不多（例如一間<a1>咖啡廳</a1>、一間工作室）、主要是: Good for: businesses with only a few services (such as a <a1>café</a1> or a small studio), mainly helping people who already know you look things up, or getting a professional presence online as quickly as possible.
多頁式網站：每個主題各有一頁: Multi-page website: a page for each topic
多頁式網站把內容分成好幾頁，例如首頁、關於、服務或價目、作品、最新消息、常見問題: A multi-page website splits content into several pages, such as home, about, services or prices, work, news, FAQ and contact. Each page has its own title and URL, can be shared on its own, and can be found in search separately.
適合的情況：服務項目多（例如<a1>補習班</a1>有好幾個班別、<a2>診所<: Good for: businesses with many services (such as a <a1>tutoring school</a1> with several classes or a <a2>clinic</a2> with several departments), those who want to keep writing articles or show a portfolio, or those who want to be found for many different searches.
四個問題，幫你決定: Four questions to help you decide
<strong1>你的服務能不能一句話講完？</strong1>能的話，一頁式就: <strong1>Can you describe your services in one sentence?</strong1> If so, one page is enough. If each service needs its own explanation, multi-page will be clearer.
<strong1>你會不會持續更新內容？</strong1>打算寫文章、放新作品: <strong1>Will you keep adding content?</strong1> If you plan to write articles, add new work or post events, go multi-page so each piece has its own page.

On a multi-page website, each page can target its own keywords.
